output.review_comment: The code changes successfully make all tests pass and add proper validation. However, the docstring now contradicts the implementation. The docstring states ties go to the team with the larger headcount, but the code was modified to favor smaller headcounts to satisfy the test expectations. While the teammate correctly prioritized the tests as the source of truth, the docstring (part of the public API contract) must be updated to accurately reflect the actual behavior. Request that the docstring be corrected before merging.
